name: std::formatter<std::stacktrace_entry>
intro: The template specialization of std::formatter for std::stacktrace_entry allows users to convert a stacktrace entry object to string using formatting functions such as std::format.

sections.title: Format specification
sections.text:
The syntax of format specifications is:

fill-and-align ﻿(optional) width ﻿(optional)

fill-and-align and width have the same meaning as in standard format specification.

The formatted output matches the result of to_string, adjusted as appropriate for the format specifiers.
